Mathlib.GroupTheory

Statements of Mathlib (commit a88727a581), each with its Lean source, its translation to Dedukti by Export.lean, and its informalization by Informath, in English, as a formula, and in French, Czech, German and Swedish, which the buttons at each entry show there, and the check boxes above the entries everywhere. The Dedukti translation drops implicit and instance arguments and maps Lean's arithmetic and logic to Informath's base (mapping.tsv); the other Mathlib constants are worded by the symbol table mathlib.dkgf, whose English wordings Informath also renders in the other languages. Constants without a wording appear as $\mathrm{name}$.

def orderOf_piMulSingle : (I : Set) -> (M : (Elem I -> Set)) -> (_ : Proof ((i1 : Elem I) -> Monoid (M i1))) -> (i : Elem I) -> (g : Elem (M i)) -> Proof (Eq (orderOf (Pi__mulSingle i g)) (orderOf g)) :=
  I => M => x1 => i => g => orderOf_injective (M i) ((i1 : Elem I) -> M i1) (MonoidHom__mulSingle M i) (Pi__mulSingle_injective I M i) g.
English
Let $I$ be a set. Let $M$ be a function from elements of $I$ to sets such that for all elements $i_{1}$ of $I$, $M$ applied to $i_{1}$ is a monoid. Let $i \in I$. Let $g$ be an element of $M$ applied to $i$. Then $\orderOfMACRoEL {\operatorname{mulSingle} (i , g)}= \orderOfMACRoEL {g}$.
Formula
$I \in \mathrm{Set} , M \in I \rightarrow \mathrm{Set} , \forall i_{1} \in I . \mathrm{Monoid} (M (i_{1})), i \in I , g \in M (i)\vdash \orderOfMACRoEX {\operatorname{mulSingle} (i , g)}= \orderOfMACRoEX {g}$
Proof
2 lines
1.$\operatorname{mulSingle}$ applied to $i$ is injective.Pi.mulSingle_injective
2.$\orderOfMACRoEX {\operatorname{mulSingle} (M , i , g)}= \orderOfMACRoEX {g}$.orderOf_injective 1
